name: Personal Data Protection Authority
text: A public authority called the “Personal Data Protection Authority” is hereby established. It shall have legal personality with financial and administrative independence and shall be subject to oversight by the Minister.

name: Board of Directors
text: The Authority shall have a Board made up of seven members, including a Chairman, and shall be constituted pursuant to a Decree as follows:

name: Chief Executive
text: The Authority shall have a Chief Executive who shall be appointed, pursuant to a Decree, for a three years term upon the recommendation of the Board. His term of office may not be renewed for more than two consecutive terms

name: Appeal Tribunal
text: A judicial tribunal shall be established within the Authority, called (Appeal Tribunal). The Tribunal shall adjudicate appeals brought before it, pursuant to paragraph (1) of this Article.

name: Investigation committee
text: The Authority may carry out the investigation, or form a tripartite internal or external committee of competent individuals. The Authority may as well assign any qualified person to carry out such task.
